Method of Attack: Fileless browser hijacker that infects browser shortcuts by adding http://yeabests.cc as an argument to the executable
Registers itself as an instance of the ActiveScriptEventConsumer class in the ROOT\subscription namespace
Executes a VBScript every 10 seconds to infect browser shortcuts to open Yeabests.cc
Deletes its installer after execution and does not create files on the hard drive, residing only in WMI
Discoverer: Djordje Lukic, malware analyst for Zemana
Attack Vector: Infection via hijacking browser shortcuts through WMI event consumer
Use of WMI to launch malicious VBScript triggered by system events
Indicators of Compromise: http://yeabests.cc URL added as argument to browser shortcut executables
WMI instance named ASEC in ROOT\subscription namespace
VBScript that modifies .lnk shortcut files to include Yeabests.cc argument
